description: Trait de côte 2004 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.karugeo.fr. Boundary of the 1950 coastline as part of the BRGM study ‘Evolution and dynamics of the coastline of the Guadeloupean archipelago’. This project consists of assessing the dynamics of the coastline of the Guadeloupean archipelago over the past 50 years, in order to better understand the phenomena linked to climate change. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Coastline 2004" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include érosion littorale, trait de côte, littoral, multi-risques. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
